synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO publishes distinct low/median/high POE demand quantiles and PASA POE demands are derived from AEMO’s operational demand forecast then adjusted for significant non‑scheduled wind/solar generation.

document_statements.paraphrase: The MMS data model includes distinct fields OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE10, OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE50 and OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE90 for operational demand forecasts.

document_statements.quote: The POE demands used in PDPASA and STPASA are derived from a forecast operational demand, determined by AEMO’s Demand Forecasting System (DFS) and the Australian Wind Energy Forecasting System (AWEFS)/Australian Solar Energy Forecasting System (ASEFS).

document_statements.paraphrase: Those POE demands for PDPASA/STPASA are obtained by deducting the demand component met by significant non‑scheduled wind/solar generation from the forecast operational demand (this derived form is referred to as operational demand less SNSG).

document_statements.quote: The 10% probability of exceedance (POE) demand is the value that 10% of the actual demand values are expected to be above and 90% of the actual demand values are expected to be below.

document_statements.paraphrase: Intermittent generation forecast tables include FORECAST_POE10, FORECAST_POE50 and FORECAST_POE90 fields, indicating probabilistic outputs exist for generation forecasts as well.

report.headline: AEMO publishes distinct low/median/high POE demand quantiles and PASA POE demands are derived from AEMO’s operational demand forecast then adjusted for significant non‑scheduled wind/solar generation.
summary: The MMS data model includes distinct fields OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE10, OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE50 and OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_POE90 for operational demand forecasts. [c1]

“The POE demands used in PDPASA and STPASA are derived from a forecast operational demand, determined by AEMO’s Demand Forecasting System (DFS) and the Australian Wind Energy Forecasting System (AWEFS)/Australian Solar Energy Forecasting System (ASEFS).” [c2]

Those POE demands for PDPASA/STPASA are obtained by deducting the demand component met by significant non‑scheduled wind/solar generation from the forecast operational demand (this derived form is referred to as operational demand less SNSG). [c2]
“The 10% probability of exceedance (POE) demand is the value that 10% of the actual demand values are expected to be above and 90% of the actual demand values are expected to be below.” [c3]
Intermittent generation forecast tables include FORECAST_POE10, FORECAST_POE50 and FORECAST_POE90 fields, indicating probabilistic outputs exist for generation forecasts as well. [c4]
